description: This file defines a PHP class 'CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI' within the OrangeHRM recruitment API module. It handles the API endpoint to mark a candidate’s interview as passed, including validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI
classes.description: API class to handle marking a candidate interview as passed, including validation, request handling, and defining the resulting workflow state.
